April, 2025

Author: Vivek Varma
Bench: Vivek Varma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:53766
Court No. - 69
Case :- Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 482 Bnss No. - 2369 of 2025

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar Singh,Naveen Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

The present application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in
Case Crime No. 144 of 2023, under Sections 308, 323, 504, 506, 498A I.P.C., and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Shaktinagar, District- Sonbhadra.

2.  After arguing the matter at some length, Sri Naveen Kumar Srivastava, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present bail application with liberty to the applicant to file regular bail application before the Court of competent jurisdiction.

Moin Ansari Alias Md. Moin vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65345064/
1 3.

entities.text: Moin Ansari Alias Md. Moin vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, this application is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to the applicant to surrender before the concerned court and file regular bail application, which shall be decided in the light of decision rendered in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another,
Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No (s) 5191 of 2021 decided on 07.10.2021.
